name: Reward Box Limit
description: The reward box holds {{slots:comma}} instead of 50.
author: KSFA

settings.label: Reward box slots
settings.help: Stock is 50. It cannot go lower, so nothing waiting in the box is lost. Capped at 500 (10x stock) - the sibling stock fields for this kind of box slot count are all exactly 50, with nothing anywhere near as high as the old 9,999 ceiling.
